Subject: BrightClinic — post-call deployment & audit sprint

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today, Amanda — good to meet the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps based on what we discussed: 

- Hosting options under consideration: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (customer-isolated GPU pool), Private VPC (VPC Peering or on-prem bundle). You mentioned strong preference for isolation due to PHI handling.
- Security asks flagged by your team: SOC 2 Type II report, BAA, and a concise data flow diagram showing PHI ingress/egress and where logs are retained.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether BrightClinic requires customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for encryption at rest?
2) Will audit access for SOC 2 evidence be scoped to specific business units or org-wide?
3) Please share any internal deadline for the procurement/PO so we can align the onboarding sprint.

Attachments I will circulate (summary + diagrams) for the security team to review. Proposed next step: 30-minute follow-up with your security lead to walk through the SOC 2 artifacts and the BAA language — are you available Wed 7/7 or Thu 7/8 10–11am PT?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks, Jordan — good recap. Quick answers and clarifications from our side: 

- Primary requirement: BAA must be in place before any PHI processing. We are inclined toward Dedicated capacity or Private VPC (depending on whether Redwood can guarantee enrollment into a BAA and provide SOC 2 artifacts). Hosted API is unlikely unless we get firm contractual assurances + key controls.
- KMS: yes, customer-managed KMS is strongly preferred for at-rest encryption.
- Scope: audit access will be limited to the clinical AI product team and InfoSec; it will not be org-wide.
- Timeline: procurement would like to close the vendor evaluation by July 22 to slot onboarding in August.

Looping in our security team (please see cc) — they will want to review the SOC 2 Type II and the data flow diagram you mentioned. Also attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (VSAQ) — we can complete it after your team shares the SOC 2 and BAA draft.

Amanda Liu
Director of Product, BrightClinic
amanda.liu@brightclinic.com
